activity-roulette.note: Grown-ups: join in, and keep it safe.

prompts.text: Build a den with cushions and blankets
Hop like a frog to the kitchen and back
Make a paper aeroplane and test it
Make up a song about breakfast
Build the tallest tower you can from spoons and cups
Do a puppet show with socks
Find something that floats and something that sinks
Make a card for someone you love
